content.short: Blocknative offers a tool suite enabling developers to work with pre-chain data in real time.
content.description: Blocknative delivers a global real-time web3 data platform that helps builders and traders observe current on-chain activity as it happens. Developers can access in-flight data to speed up transaction distribution and improve throughput. The platform also supports adding ready-to-connect wallets to dapps, with hardware and software wallets supported. Through Mempool Explorer, users can create custom real-time data streams and deliver them to a webhook for automation and monitoring.
content.meta: Blocknative offers a web3 data platform used by builders and traders to monitor activity. Discover Blocknative and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
